title: Topic 1
japanese_text: 気候、<u>風土</u>と食文化は<u>密接な</u>関係にあり、同じ国でも地域によって異なる料理があるのが面白い。<u>それゆえ</u>、その食の違いに魅せられて <u>頻繁</u>に国内を旅行する人も少なくない。
english_translation: Climate, cultural climate, and culinary culture have a close relationship, and it is interesting to see how different regions of the same country have differing cuisines. Therefore, people frequently travel within a country, fascinated by these culinary differences.
